newsitem.title: USA: Novametrix merger plan gets outside backing.
newsitem.headline: Novametrix merger plan gets outside backing.

text.p: Novametrix Medical Systems Inc said on Monday that an independent shareholder advisory group backed Novametrix's director nominees, its long-term incentive plan and the company's merger agreement with Andros Inc.

A dissenting shareholder group has argued that the merger with Andros, a unit of GenStar Capital Partners II LP, would not benefit Novametrix shareholders because of Andros's high debt level and recent poor performance, Novametrix said. The company said the dissenting group also believed the merger would be dilutive.

Institutional Shareholder Services recommended Novametrix holders vote for the plans, based on an independent review of proxy statements, and talks with management and the leader of the dissent group, Novametrix said.
Under the previously announced merger terms, Novametrix would issue Andros shareholders Novametrix common stock constituting 38 percent of the combined company at closing, the company said.
